APPENDIX 27  Exchange Lists for Meal Planning
1028
ALCOHOL
Nutrition Tips
	1.	 In general, 1 alcohol choice (1⁄2 oz absolute alcohol) has 
about 100 calories.
Selection Tips
	1.	 If you choose to drink alcohol, you should limit it to 1 drink 
or less per day for women, and 2 drinks or less per day for 
men.
	2.	 To reduce your risk of low blood glucose (hypoglycemia), 
especially if you take insulin or a diabetes pill that increases 
insulin, always drink alcohol with food.
	3.	 While alcohol, by itself, does not directly affect blood 
glucose, be aware of the carbohydrate (for example, in 
mixed drinks, beer, and wine) that may raise your blood 
glucose.
	4.	 Check with your RD if you would like to fit alcohol into your 
meal plan.
